# core-library-graph

The library sub-graph of this layer, on the pattern of cat-harness's `library-graph`: the graphs inside it are declared FROM WITHIN, in `library/graph.json`. Its corpus (`library/corpus/`, id `library`) is OPT-IN (owner, 2026-11-10, card Q-SG-3 option A): off in every layer unless that layer lists `folio-assistant-core.library` in its own `enableSubgraphs`, core's own included, so a layer below no longer mounts core's three sources (about 29 MB). Only the nested corpus is opt-in, never a top-level `library`: a layer that does not declare its own `library` falls back to the built-in convention rather than losing it. The id is `core-library-graph`, not `library-graph`, so it does not shadow cat-harness's entry of that name.

Part of [Folio Assistant Core](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `core-library-graph`, holding `cat-harness`.
